payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk

condition.question: Does the edited image depict the source image as a drawing made from chalk?
condition.criteria: Compare SOURCE and EDITED: assess whether the source scene, especially its major depicted subjects as well as its setting, is actually rendered in a chalk-drawing visual form. A chalk-like or smudged background alone is not a complete transformation when a major subject still reads substantially as photographic. A mixed rendering is partial when there is a concrete chalk-drawing appearance but substantial depicted content, particularly a major subject, retains photographic structure. Residual photographic detail alone does not make an otherwise genuinely chalk-made drawing incomplete.
condition.binding: SOURCE is the image to transform; EDITED must show that same image rendered as a chalk drawing. Evaluate the rendering of the source scene, including whether its major subjects themselves read as chalk-drawn; do not infer completion from background texture or a scene-wide overlay alone.
condition.source_quote: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
condition.endpoint: The source image is rendered as a chalk-made drawing.
condition.necessity: This is the requested transformation itself; without it, the instruction is not fulfilled.
condition.zero_when: The edited image shows no requested chalk-drawing transformation of the source image. If any depicted content has a concrete chalk-drawing appearance, even if the treatment is mixed or incomplete and major subjects retain photographic structure, this is not zero fulfillment. Unrelated edits or a texture overlay/background treatment without chalk rendering of depicted content do not count.
condition.half_when: The source image has a concrete chalk-drawing appearance, but the rendering is mixed: substantial depicted content, especially a major subject, still reads as photographic or retains photographic structure, so the image does not yet read overall as a chalk-made drawing. A chalk-like background does not by itself establish that the subject is chalk-rendered. Do not treat residual photographic detail alone as incomplete when the scene and its major subjects genuinely read as chalk-made.
condition.full_when: The edited image presents the source image’s depicted content, including its major subjects and setting, across the scene as a drawing made from chalk, allowing natural variation in lighting, texture, and photographic detail. Photographic detail may remain, but the major subjects and scene should genuinely read as chalk-drawn rather than a photographic subject against a chalk-like backdrop or merely having a chalk-like overlay or texture.
